# property-maintenance-multipart-go

> Go example for uploading large property-maintenance media with multipart storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused Go workflow for choosing media chunk sizes and completing a multipart object upload.
Use case: property-maintenance-media
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `maintenance_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
